description: Read a file from a sandbox. Text comes back 60,000 bytes at a time (a longer file's answer gives the offset to read on from). PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images up to 5 MB come back as images; other binary files need encoding "base64" (up to 1 MiB). Paths are absolute under /home/prized, or relative to /home/prized/work. To list a directory, use run_command (ls -la).

encoding.description: Leave out to get text (or an image); "base64" for the raw bytes of a binary file; "utf8" to force text.

offset.description: For text: the byte to read from, as the previous answer gave it. Default 0.

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox id (sbx_...), from create_sandbox or list_sandboxes.

name: read_file
title: Read a file from a sandbox
